Name: (CP) Sugarmaples' Cuter Jellies
Author: sugarmaples
Description:
[center]Changes the river jelly, sea jelly, and cave jelly into cute little jellyfish! Colours are kept close to their vanilla counterparts, but I might make additional options in the future! (Pink cave jelly? Purple cave jelly? Seasonal river jelly? Who knows...)

This mod REQUIRES Content Patcher. Should work with﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915]Better Fishing and Beach Foraging[/url] by default, as well as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17725?tab=description]1.6 addon[/url]﻿ for it.
If you encounter any issues with other fish replacement mods, please leave a comment and I'll work on a fix!
